summary: Added the explicit per-request skip_cache_insert field across native, Engine, OpenAI chat/completions/responses, tokenizer, scheduler, session, encoder, and rebootstrap paths. Cache lookup remains enabled while device/HiCache insertion is suppressed and request-owned KV is released.
